audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows contradict the prose directly beneath them and the already-applied mirror. Rows 0-2 and 4 read Yasuo while whys[0]-[4] say every one of those stages is yours; row 3 reads Skill while whys[3] says it is yours; row 5 reads Skill while the mirror gives First item to Yasuo.
audit.why: The mirror (yasuo__yorick) locked rows 0-4 to Yorick and rows 5-6 to Yasuo. Ours currently reads as the opposite lane.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 -> Yorick at 7/10, row 5 -> Yasuo at 3/10, row 6 left Yasuo. whys[5] rewritten so it stops claiming First item for you.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text told the reader trades still favour him through Yasuo's first crit item, on the row the mirror gives to Yasuo.
audit.why: IE/Shieldbow is the swing: his crit output passes ghoul chip. The answer is armour and a freeze, not another trade.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now names the crit item as the swing and keys your fight window to Wind Wall's 25/23/21/19/17s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claims 'His Last Breath (R) needs a knockup, and you give him none — his ult is dead in a 1v1'. It is repeated in whys[4] and content.mid. That is false and it is the most dangerous line on the page.
audit.why: Riot's Steel Tempest text: 'At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne.' Yasuo supplies his own knockup with the third Q, 475 range on a 4s base, and Last Breath is 1400 range on 70/50/30s. A player told the ult cannot happen will stand in the whirlwind.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4] and content.mid all now say the ult lands off his own Q3 whirlwind and tell you to sidestep that cast. The six do/don't bodies also replaced with real mechanics: Wind Wall's 4s block of Mourning Mist only, ghouls and Maiden autos passing through it, Dark Procession's 20s destructible wall, and the Steel Tempest stack count.

edits.before: Level 6 is yours because Last Breath is dead without a knockup you never give.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours if you sidestep the Q3 whirlwind that feeds Last Breath.

edits.before: First item still favours you as ghouls ignore his shield and freezes hold.
edits.after: First item goes to Yasuo as crit finally outpaces your ghoul chip.

edits.before: His Last Breath (R) needs a knockup, and you give him none — your kit has no airborne trigger, so his ult is dead in a 1v1. Meanwhile your Maiden plus ghoul wall out-sustains his trades; keep E slow on him and he can't win a straight fight.
edits.after: Last Breath (R) needs an airborne target and he makes his own: the third Steel Tempest fires a knock-up whirlwind at 475 range. Sidestep that cast and his 70/50/30s ult has nothing to blink to, while Maiden and the ghoul wall out-sustain his trades.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay dominant: cage him with W as he dashes, slow with E, and let ghouls grind through his shield. His R is dead without a knockup, so a 1v1 always favours you — deny his farm and deny his scaling.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay dominant: cage him with W as he dashes, slow with E, and let ghouls grind through his shield. His R only lands off his own Q3 whirlwind, so sidestep that cast and the 1v1 stays yours.

edits.before: Yasuo's item spike is real (IE/Shieldbow crit), but you should be even or ahead in CS and can freeze. Bramble/tabis blunt his crit; your ghouls ignore his shield entirely so trades still favour you if he steps up.
edits.after: Yasuo's first crit item (IE/Shieldbow) is the swing — his output now passes your ghoul chip. Take Plated Steelcaps and Bramble, freeze the wave off him, and only take the fight while Wind Wall's 25/23/21/19/17s is still on cooldown.

edits.before: Blocks your E (Mourning Mist). Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Wind Wall eats Mourning Mist for 4s on 25/23/21/19/17s — bait it first.

edits.before: Raise 3-4 ghouls, E-mark Yasuo so they leap, W-cage the retreat, and AA alongside the swarm — the ghouls out-damage you both.
edits.after: Send the ghoul wave in first: the Wall stops your E projectile but never ghoul or Maiden autos, so the cooldown buys him nothing.

edits.before: Yasuo wastes Wind Wall — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Dark Procession is a 20s destructible wall — cage his dash out.

edits.before: That is Yasuo's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Throwing a 700-range E into the Wall spends 12 seconds of cooldown on nothing.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Two Steel Tempest stacks make the third an airborne — count them.

edits.before: Trading without ghouls or caging nothing — Yorick without the swarm is the worst duelist in the lane.
edits.after: Sweeping Blade is near-cooldownless off fresh targets — never brawl him in his own minion wave.

notes: Yasuo's E cannot re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds, which raises the question of whether your Mist Walkers count as fresh dash targets and effectively give him free mobility in a swarm. Riot's text does not say, so I did not put it on the page — see unverified.
